lines.text: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Jabez called out to the God of Israel to bless him and enlarge his territory, and God granted it.
Mered's wife Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, so the clan of Simeon became more numerous than Judah.

wrong_details.wrong: the clan of Simeon became more numerous than Judah
wrong_details.true: their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah

lines.text: Five hundred Simeonites went to Mount Carmel and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped.
